name: Someone to Clap
tagline: A small crew applauds you. Booing is not available.
summary: A crew arrives at your address and claps for a named person at a named moment. Three packages, four add-ons.
concept: Some achievements get a room of people. Others get one person in a kitchen. We send the room.
who_its_for: Anyone marking a finished thesis, a driving test, a first loaf or the end of a long week.
how_it_works: Choose a package and any add-ons.
Pick a slot at least 72 hours ahead: 10:00, 13:00, 16:00 or 19:00, Monday to Saturday.
Give us the exact address, the name of the person being clapped and the moment to start.
The crew arrives a few minutes early and waits out of sight.
At the agreed moment they clap for the length of the package, then leave.

page.headline: Applause, on request.
page.intro: A small crew applauds you. Booing is not available.

sections.title: Three packages
sections.body: Polite Ripple is 3 people for 2 minutes. Warm Reception is 6 for 5. Standing Ovation is 12 for 10. Prices are on each package.

sections.title: Add-ons
sections.body: Light cheering, one whoop, an encore, and paper flowers thrown and collected afterwards. Priced separately and can be combined.

sections.title: What we will not do
sections.body: No funerals, courts, exams or medical appointments. No booing, heckling or sarcastic clapping. Nobody is clapped for unless they have agreed.

faq.q: How much notice do you need?
What do I have to tell you?
faq.a: The exact address, the name of the person to be clapped, and the moment the clapping should start.

faq.q: Does the person being clapped need to know?
faq.a: They need to have agreed to it. The exact time can still be a surprise.
Full refund up to 48 hours before, half refund up to 24 hours before, none after that.
Once, free, up to 48 hours before, if a crew is free. A second change costs £15.
Within 30 miles of us is included. Up to 60 miles costs £1 per extra mile. We do not go further.

faq.q: Can you clap at a wedding or a party?
faq.a: Yes, if the venue lets us in and any tickets needed have been bought for the crew.

faq.q: What are the flowers made of?
